description: Readable movement groups and label/control rhythm (REQ-017; C05, C42, C47; R108, R109, R111, R112, R131) delivered as shared-provider contracts over the accepted gallery reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d (REUSE.md, LOGGING-FIELDS.md): tokens.css --logging-movement-gap (the extra space between two complete movement-entry groups), --logging-movement-field-gap (the fields inside one movement, TASK-015's value unchanged), --logging-label-gap (a choice legend to its controls, the labelled field's rhythm) and --logging-count-gap (the ladder log's tiles to its dynamic count), each over a Foundation spacing step; presentation.css .clr-logging-movement (adopted by TimedResultLog's per-movement groups and the superset round's movements) and the legend rhythm of .clr-timed-log, .clr-accepted-log (anything the focused logging frame holds) and .clr-logging-movement, the ladder's Rounds completed heading gap kept; and the superset round's added helper paragraph removed from SupersetRoundSheet (SetLoggingSheet context now optional) with no replacement prose and the Performed / blank-is-not-recorded semantics unchanged. Checked at the shared-component boundary with representative consumers (TimedResultLog For Time inline and in LoggingOverlay, its ladder log at four and twelve rounds, SupersetRoundSheet over a memory set-logging seam, the frame's Workout feedback specimen) and the accepted gallery state /gallery/refinements?state=for_time, with spacing read from the stylesheet cascade (jsdom has no layout). /gallery/refinements?state=superset does not exist yet; it arrives with its route consumer (TASK-044).
